note: Where the Ono plugins write files into a work repo. Ono rule (2026-11-10): only code goes into a commit by default — the files on the 'commit' lists below stay OUT unless the employee asks for one or the project lists it in .platform-guardian.json commitPaths. Exceptions, committed with the code: the inspector's outputs, and (dev plugin 0.8.0, 2026-11-23) the planning and review documents on 'requiredInPr' — the dev plugin's PR-readiness check blocks a PR without them. The session closer never .gitignores these. Patterns are git-style globs relative to the repo root. 'neverCommit' lists plugin scratch files that land in the repo but must not be committed. Generated ledger/readiness files must never be edited, formatted or line-ending-normalized.

ono-mobile-dev-plugin.frontmatterDocs: Feature Analysis, Detailed Design, Task Breakdown and Dev Plan have no fixed filename: a new .md whose frontmatter (--- block or ```yaml fence near the top) has doc_schema_version + feature: is a planning doc → requiredInPr. Unstamped legacy docs aren't recognised: the closer stages the paths the readiness check lists (documents.required) and the employee confirms any the guard still holds back.
ono-mobile-dev-plugin.evidence: docs/task-state-contract.md:20, docs/bug-work-plan-contract.md:412, scripts/reference-integrity.ts:331; scratch is written outside the repo. 0.8.0: docs/pr-readiness-contract.md § Required documents, docs/guardian-integration.md § 4 (*.tmp atomic-write files stay out).
